issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

pipelineSpec.description:
The pipeline construction for the document parser.
This should contain specs for layout parser, table parser, image parser, and text parser.
A default {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.Mew3.Config} is seeded and accessible with #inst

documentSpec.description:
The configuration for the document itself (for example, handling cropping with different libraries).
A default {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.Mew3.Config} is seeded and accessible with #inst

skipTextParsing.description: Whether to skip parsing text components.

skipImageParsing.description: Whether to skip parsing image components.

skipTableParsing.description: Whether to skip parsing table components.

additionalSettings.description: Additional fields to set in mew3.settings.

pageChunks.description: The number of chunks to split the document into

mew3WheelPath.description:
The path in FileSystem storing the Mew3 wheel, which will be pip-installed.
Until the wheel can be cleanly included directly in the Python runtime, this allows
installing a wheel included in the genAiBase package itself.
